stem: The depth of snow on a mountain trail, in centimeters, \(h\) hours after noon on a warm day is modeled by \(S(h) = 42 - 3.5h\). According to the model, how many hours after noon will the depth of snow be 14 centimeters?
verify:
h = symbols('h')
sol = solve(Eq(42 - Rational(7, 2)*h, 14), h)
assert sol == [8]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
